id_vocabulary.part_keys: parts are keyed: <part>[<data-key>] chained by ancestor parts, e.g. item[production].indicator, row[0].cell[1]; generation fails on duplicate keys

notes.measurement_order: font proof (mutation pass, fully reverted) -> force pseudo states -> settle (3x rAF + fonts.ready) -> measure -> token-binding eval + pressed parity in the same session -> screenshot: the contract records the PAINTED post-force state (R01); bindings_live values were read immediately before each screenshot
notes.baseline_formula: baseline_y = line_rect_top + fontBoundingBoxAscent of the run's effective font (canvas measureText); each line validated against rendered ink: inside the line box always, and inside the ink band (+descent) for letter/digit runs
notes.control_text: input/textarea text_runs are measured via a mirror element with identical box/font styles (value + placeholder); browser editing behavior is not authority
notes.geometry: placements/box measured post-force in light theme; dark geometry asserted identical
notes.pixel_guard: every forced-state specimen with a same-size unforced twin must produce a different screenshot crop (4px pad absorbs the pressed +1px translate)
